name: adison-rps-event-v2
description: 가위바위보 챌린지 v2 — docs/guide 정본 기반 상용 빌드

scripts.install:all: cd functions && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:functions && npm run lint:web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:functions && npm run type-check:web
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions --force
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
